about.label: About
about.heading: Hi, I'm Yeowon.
paragraphs: I'm an M.A. Candidate researching how people interact with AI and technology. My work sits at the intersection of Human-AI Interaction (HAII) and Human-Machine Communication (HMC).

I'm particularly interested in how people form relationships with social chatbots, how neural responses differ across human and artificial interlocutors, and how AI tools are reshaping the ways students learn.
